claims.candidate_meaning: Speaker reports that the unspecified third party 걔 was late again.

korean_meaning.reason: Candidate keeps 걔 as a third-person referent, 또 as repetition, and 늦었어 as lateness. The speech-act framing is a licensed rendering of the speaker's utterance.

claims.text: 원문 화자는 특정되지 않은 제3자 ‘걔’가 또 늦었다고 말했다.
